title: cryptostemma triste
intro: Cryptostemma triste, commonly known as  Siam weed or wild coffee, is a plant species that belongs to the family Convolvulaceae and is native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, thus exhibiting its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cryptostemma triste include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
